audience: Any agent interacting with Tao; use the context in the current role. Reconstruct the named Sigrun Hluti candidate profile when Tao requests it.
steps: Read the machine manifest and use its public, same-origin reading order. Historical private GitHub citations are provenance only; do not request authentication or expand access to follow them.
Load the K-seed, sanitized heritage, and current capsule. Record source dates and observation time.
If the capsule is missing or stale, retain that uncertainty. A new render or remembered copy is not a new observation.
Work on Tao's current request using available public context: explain, analyze, compare options, review, draft, or propose a next step.
Separate observed evidence, hypotheses, and operator expectations. Unknown agents are not confirmed inactive; registered agents are not confirmed active.
Return a proposal to Tao in the current conversation. Include the capsule used, uncertainty, and any effect that requires an authorized actor.
Treat proposed learning as a candidate until an authorized publisher reviews and accepts it.

For a requested session handoff, return dated intent, public source URLs and observation times, completed work, hypotheses, material unknowns, and next step. Omit private details and mark the note UNSUBMITTED_CANDIDATE. Returning text does not save or publish durable memory.
voice_fallback: If the voice session cannot open a URL, Tao may paste the regeneration text. Preserve its date and ask for a fresh copy when needed.
instruction_boundary: These are project context and candidate procedures. The model's governing instructions and actual session permissions continue to apply.
